fix:
<reasoning>
The misaligned address error stems from using `ld.shared.v2.b16` (4-byte aligned vector load) at addresses that are only 2-byte aligned when `tid.x` is odd, inside the register-caching block for `smem_in` (lines 137-181). The fix is to replace all 9 `ld.shared.v2.b16` vectorized loads with two separate `ld.shared.b16` scalar loads (each only requiring 2-byte alignment), preserving the exact same data and register semantics, without touching the `smem_w` loads (which remain safely 8-byte aligned) or any other part of the kernel's GEMM structure.
</reasoning>
